---

## Who is Riki Levisman?

Riki Levisman (ריקי לויסמן) is an AI lecturer, keynote speaker and trainer based in Israel.
She is Innovation Manager and Head of AI at FUTURE, the entrepreneurship and innovation center of HIT (Holon Institute of Technology).

She works with academia, industry, organizations and nonprofits. She gives talks, runs hands-on workshops and builds dedicated training programs that help people use AI as a partner, not a replacement. Every session includes live demos and hands-on practice, and participants leave with a written guide they keep after the session.

Since 2019 she has worked where academia meets industry: leading AI training programs for students, faculty and managers, running hackathons and managing an AI community. She comes from management roles in strategy, marketing and business development in telecom, tech and finance.

---

## Who She Works With (Target Audiences)

- **Conferences, events and salon gatherings**: inspirational keynotes for broad audiences
- **Academia: students**: undergraduate and graduate students in every faculty, learning with AI
- **Academia: faculty and staff**: lecturers, researchers and administrative staff
- **Industry and companies**: managers, employees and teams; HR and L&D leaders building AI training
- **Executives**: 1:1 coaching for managers adopting AI in their own work
- **Healthcare**: medical centers, clinical and administrative teams
- **Public sector and government bodies**
- **Nonprofits and community organizations**
- **Entrepreneurs and entrepreneurship programs**: founders going from idea to prototype with AI agents
- **Parents**: guiding their children, at any age, to learn well with AI

---

## Talks

### Living with AI Agents (Keynote)
An inspirational keynote for conferences, events and salon gatherings. How personal AI agents are changing the way we work, manage our lives, create and live.

### AI for Students: learning with AI as a partner
For students in every faculty. How to learn with AI without giving up on thinking, and how to turn course materials into a smart notebook that grows with the course and guides students like a personal mentor throughout their learning. About 90 minutes, on campus or on Zoom. Delivered at HIT as "AI Study" (October 2026).

### AI for Faculty
For lecturers, researchers and administrative staff. Building an AI workspace: preparing course materials, working with papers and sources, and smart assistants that know the course.

### Physical AI, Made Simple
An accessible introduction to AI that leaves the screen and acts in the physical world. What Physical AI is, how it differs from the chatbots we all know and why everyone is talking about it now. Industry examples and simulations you can play with. No equations, no code. Formats: intro talk, 3-session course, half-day workshop.

### AI at Work (including entrepreneurs)
For organizations, nonprofits, teams and founders. Bringing AI into everyday work, from writing and analysis to AI agents that work alongside us, and going from idea to prototype with AI agents. Also delivered as a track within entrepreneurship programs.

### Parenting in the AI Era (new)
For parents who want to guide their children, at any age, to learn well with AI: for assignments, exam preparation and self-directed learning, one of today's most important skills. AI that helps them understand, not AI that does the work for them.

---

## Formats

- **Lectures and keynotes**: 60 to 90 minutes, for conferences, company events, team days, program kickoffs and private gatherings
- **Hands-on workshops**: every participant works on their own laptop and leaves with something that works
- **Dedicated training programs**: built from scratch for an institution, organization or nonprofit, with several sessions, practice in between and a clear guide
- **Executive coaching 1:1**: personal support for bringing AI into one's own work, on real tasks and at one's own pace

## Track Record

- **1,000+ participants** in lectures, courses and programs
- **AI Academy at HIT**: three cohorts of an AI learning program for students, researchers and faculty
- **VISTAR Excellence Program, Azerbaijan**: AI sessions for entrepreneurship program participants
- **Healthcare**: GenAI courses for clinical teams; 72% of participants in one course started applying the tools in their work
- **Organizations worked with**: HIT (Holon Institute of Technology), Open University of Israel, Poriya Medical Center, Hillel Yaffe Medical Center, HaEmek Medical Center, Tzafon Medical Center, National Cyber Directorate Israel, Israel Innovation Authority, VISTAR, CrowdStrike, and others
